output.fix: Make the IdP entityID configured on the SP match the Issuer in the response exactly, character for character, including the trailing slash. Copy it from the IdP metadata instead of typing it. Keep the strict comparison and don't normalize or ignore the issuer check. Also check the Google SAML app settings. The Entity ID and ACS URL there must match the SP values (https://sp.example.com/saml/metadata and https://sp.example.com/saml/acs). The app_not_configured_for_user error usually means Google can't match the SP's Entity ID or ACS to the app, even when the user is assigned.
